title: Expand anonymous Worker edge caching to high-traffic public catalog, sales, suggestions, and builds routes

endpoints.before: Returned Cache-Control: public, max-age=0 with no CDN-Cache-Control and bypassed the anonymous Worker edge cache on every request.
endpoints.after: Origin edgeCacheHeaders emits Cache-Control: public, max-age=60, s-maxage=900, stale-while-revalidate=600 and CDN-Cache-Control: public, max-age=900, stale-while-revalidate=3600 (varying on Cookie when country is omitted), and eligible anonymous GET/HEAD requests with an explicit country are cached at the Worker edge for 15 minutes.

endpoints.before: Bypassed the anonymous Worker edge cache and forwarded every anonymous GET/HEAD request to origin.
endpoints.after: Eligible anonymous GET/HEAD requests use the isolated public Worker edge cache with origin's 5-minute CDN TTL.
